Madam / Dear Sir, 
 
Sub: Scheduling of meeting with Analysts / Institutional Investors 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 (6) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, read with Schedule III Part A (15) ibid, we inform that 
the representatives of The Karnataka Bank Limited will interact with Analysts / 
Institutional Investors through multiple Group and one-on-one meetings organized by 
M/s. Ernst & Young LLP, on September 10, 2026 and September 11, 2026, at Mumbai, as 
detailed hereunder:
